approved_amendments.scope: Materialize the bounded Builder output lifecycle standard and LEAP-002 case record specified in this WCS.
limits: No Builder script changes or execution.
No package regeneration, overwrite, movement, archiving, or deletion.
No deployment, runtime, database, Supabase, or secret-value changes.

execution.objective: Materialize a bounded repository Builder output lifecycle and qualification standard, plus a LEAP-002 case record, after this WCS receives separate founder approval.
design_direction_for_review: Use PIC-001 as the contract for the execution package consumed by implementation engines; document how the active Builder process specifications relate to it without silently superseding them.
Define generated output as a Builder-produced candidate and materialized output as a persisted artifact whose lineage and integrity are recorded.
Require a passing qualification record, integrity evidence, source authority lineage, and a manifest before representing an output as delivery-ready.
Keep the identical LEAP-002 generated/materialized pair under REVIEW until authoritative evidence establishes its lifecycle roles.
success_criteria: Create a LEAP-002 case record under execution/workspace/REP-STEWARD-022/ documenting the identical pair, NOT_QUALIFIED state, empty builder evidence, score zero, and unresolved lifecycle classification.
Define lifecycle state ownership, provenance, allowed transitions, qualification requirements, delivery-candidate eligibility, and exception handling.
Reconcile PIC-001, the active Builder contract/specification documents, the certified runtime contract, and BOQ-001; document unresolved precedence questions.
State clearly that identical content does not establish redundant purpose or authorize deletion.
Do not edit or execute Builder scripts.
Do not regenerate, overwrite, move, archive, or delete package artifacts.
Do not deploy or change runtime, database, Supabase, or secret values.

unlocks: Future Builder implementation changes only under a separate bounded authority.
Any package cleanup only under a separate itemized WCS and authority.

forbidden_surface: Package creation, regeneration, overwrite, or mutation
Deletion, movement, rename, archive, or cleanup
Deployment, database, Supabase, and secret values

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A WCS draft is staged for founder review; no lifecycle standard or case record is created in this cycle.
